text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, Transcend.
Curiosity through the roof."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna find out, you know?
About the 'unknown' in racing."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Let's enjoy a truly spine-tingling race.
Right, Trai-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
